title: Implement isolated executor result and PR flow
businessObjective: Advance Phase 4 provider-neutral bounded execution through one isolated result and pull-request outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement isolated task-workspace execution, structured results, branches, and pull-request-only delivery for approved ExecutorAdapter work.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: Each execution uses one bounded isolated workspace with collision prevention, deterministic cleanup eligibility, and evidence-preserving failure recovery.
Structured results record requested capabilities, commands, changed paths, tests, unresolved risks, branch, and pull-request reference.
Concurrency and timeout enforcement remain outside the model; timeout or worker loss fails closed and safely requeues or dead-letters through the workflow.
Tier 0 delivery stops at an authorized branch or draft pull request and cannot deploy or merge.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the execution branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
